questions.question: The length breadth and height of a cuboid are in the ratio 4: 3: 2. If the volume of the cuboid is 1536 cubic cm, then what will be the total surface area of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

The volume of cuboid = L × B × H

Total surface area of cuboid = 2 (LB + BH + HL)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1b2b23ef2115674c7f15da3549bf17b7c0674dc20211e8abf0825be45bc0ac0.png] 

L × B × H = 1536

Let the length breadth and height of a cuboid be in the ratio 4x: 3x: 2x

⇒ 24 x³ = 1536

⇒ 1536/24 = x³ 

⇒ x³ = 64

⇒ x = 4

Total surface area of cuboid = 2 × (12x² + 6x² + 8x²) = 52x²

**∴ Total surface area of cuboid = 52 × 16 = 832 cm²**

questions.question: Ram, Sita, and Salma invest ₹ 16000, ₹ 22000 and ₹ 18000 respectively to start a business. If the profit at the end of the year is ₹ 26600, then what is the share of Ram?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Profit = investment × time

**Calculation:**

Total profit = Rs. 26600

Profit of Ram = 16000 × 12

Profit of Sita = 22000 × 12

Profit of Salma = 18000 × 12

Share of Ram = [(16000 × 12)/(12 × (16000 + 22000 + 18000))] × 26600 

⇒ [16000/56000] × 26600

∴ Share of Ram = Rs. 7600

questions.question:
What is the median of the given data?

2, 3, 2, 3, 6, 5, 4, 7
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2, 3, 2, 3, 6, 5, 4, 7

**Concept used:**

If total number is odd: The median of a data set is the number that is the middle value of the set after arranging the data in increasing order.

If total number is even: The median of a data set is the number that is the (middle values)/2 after arranging the data in increasing order.

**Calculation:**

Here total number is 8 i.e. is even

∴ 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, median = (3 + 4)/2 = 3.5

**∴ The median is 3.5.**

questions.question: A student got 24% marks in an exam and he failed by 56 marks. If he got 60% marks, then his marks are 70 more than the minimum passing marks. What is the maximum marks for the exam?
questions.solution:
Let the passing marks be P and Maximum marks be M

The student got 24% marks in an exam and he failed by 56 marks

∴ P - 24% of M = 56 ---- (1)

And, 60% of M - P = 70 ---- (2)

Adding equation 1 and 2

36% of M = 126

⇒ M = 12600/36 = 350

∴ The maximum marks for the exam = 350

questions.question: Mohit purchases eggs at the rate of ₹ 3 per egg and sells them at the rate of ₹ 5 per egg. On selling 35 eggs, what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Profit = SP - CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Here, SP → Selling price, CP → Cost price

**Calculation:**

Cost price of 35 eggs = 35 × 3 = Rs. 105

Selling price of 35 eggs = 35 × 5 = Rs. 175

Profit = 175 - 105 = 70

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

⇒ (70/105) × 100 = 66.66%

questions.question: Compound interest received on a sum in year is ₹ 1200 (interest is compounded annually).If the rate of interest is 22.5% per annum, then what will be the interest in 6th year?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

CI = Rs. 1200

Rate = 22.5%

**FORMULAE USED:**

CI = P{(1 + r/100)ⁿ - 1}

**CALCULATION:**

According to question

1200 = P × 22.5/100

P = 16000/3

CI at the end of 6 years

CI = 16000/3{(122.5/100)⁶ - 1} = 12689

CI at the end of 5 years

CI = 16000/3{(122.5/100)⁵ - 1} = 9379

Compound interest for the 6th year = CI at the end of 6 years - CI at the end of 5 years = 3310

questions.question: What is the value of [75 div 25 of ((4)/(3)- (1)/(2) + (1)/(6))]?
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below.
Step - 1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and following BODMAS rule in the bracket -
Step - 2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next.
Step - 3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated.
Step - 4: Last but not the least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

**Calculation:**

75 ÷ 25 of {(8 - 3 + 1)/6}

⇒ 75 ÷ 25 of 1

⇒ 75 ÷ 25 = 3

questions.question: F alone can complete a work in 24 days and G alone can complete the same work in 32 days. F and G start the work together but G leaves the work 8 days before the completion of work. In how many days the total work will be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by F alone = 24 days

Time is taken by G alone = 32 days

G leaves the work 8 days before the completion of work

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Time taken × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be LCM of 24 and 32 i.e. 96 unit

Work done by F in 1 day = 96/24 = 4 unit

Work done by G in 1 day = 96/32 = 3 unit

G leaves the work 8 days before the completion of work, so F worked alone for 8 days

Work done by F in 8 days = 4 × 8 = 32 unit

Work left = 96 - 32 = 64 unit

64 unit work is done by both G and F

Time taken to complete 64 unit work = 64/(4 + 3) = 64/7 days

**∴ Total time taken = 8 days + 64/7 days = 120/7 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50611c317436a04c99841f95bfd86c9e8e35963771c9b7ea210fcdb20ec75d85.png] 

∴ Total time taken = 8 days + 64/7 days = 120/7 days

questions.question: Working 2 hours in a day, P can complete a work in 10 days and working 5 hours in a day, Q can complete the same work in 6 days. Working 3 hours in a day, in how many days both P and Q together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total time taken by P to complete the work = 2 × 10 = 20 hours

Total time taken by Q to complete the work = 5 × 6 = 30 hours

Let the total work be LCM of 20 and 30 i.e. 60 unit

One days work of P = 60/20 = 3 unit

One day work of Q = 60/30 = 2 unit

**Time taken to complete the work by both P and Q working 3 hours a day = 60/{3 × (3 + 2)} = 4 days**

questions.question: The average weight of 12 boxes is 63 kg. If four boxes having an average weight of 70 kg are removed, then what will be new average weight of the remaining boxes?
questions.solution:
Average weight of 12 boxes = 63 kg

Total weight of 12 boxes = 12 × 63 = 756

Average of 4 boxes = 70 kg

Total weight of 4 boxes = 70 × 4 = 280 kg

These 4 boxes are removed, Total weight left = 756 - 280 = 476 kg

Total box left = 12 - 4 = 8

Average weight of remaining 8 boxes = 476/8 = 59.5 kg

questions.question: A bike covers a certain distance at a speed of 56 km/hr in 16 hours. How much time it will take to cover the same distance at the speed of 64 km/hr?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the bike = 56 km/hr 

Time = 16 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered at 56 km/hour = 56 × 16 = 896 km

New speed = 64 km/hour

Distance is same as previous,

 Time = 896/64 = 14 hour

**∴ 14 hours it will take to cover the same distance at the speed of 64 km/hr**

questions.question: What will be the Highest Common Factor of 5, 10 and 20?
questions.solution:
HCF is defined as the largest positive integer that divides the numbers without leaving a remainder.

Using prime factorization method:

20 = 2 × 2 × 5

10 = 2 × 5

5 = 1 × 5

∴ Common factors of 5, 10 and 20 = 5

Hence HCF of 5, 10 and 20 = 5

questions.question: Mohit and Sumit start a business with investment of ₹ 74000 and ₹ 96000 respectively. If at the end of the year they earn profit in the ratio of 5 : 8, then what will be ratio of the time period for which they invest their money?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Profit = investment × Time period

**Calculation:**

Let T1 and T2 be time periods of Mohit and Sumit respectively

5 = 74000 × T1

T1 = 5/74000

8 = 96000 × T2

T2 = 8/96000

Ratio of T1/T2 = (5/74000)/(8/96000) = 30: 37

questions.question: Curved surface area of a cylinder is 110 cm². If the height of cylinder is 5 cm, then what will be the diameter of its base?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 110 cm2

Height = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

r → radius 

h → height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5582063c43f36a97ddad238f491c0f35d4514a40c5b03d5eab8e6eef59a14573.png] 

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πr × h = 110 cm²

⇒ 2πr × 5 = 110 

⇒ 22/7 × r = 11 

⇒ r = 7/2

⇒ d = 2r = 2 × 7/2 = 7

**∴ Diameter of its base is 7 cm**
